mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of industrial production above 105 and consumer spending above 506,000 million dollars indicates robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO > 105 and RSAFS > 506000.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS above 2.5%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates improving employment conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1.2 million units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) signals a tight labor market with robust manufacturing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightness with strong manufacturing
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0 and INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (GDP growth between 0% and 2.0% YoY), stretched valuations lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 YoY growth is between 0% and 2.0%.
